name: IntegrateIT UniFi NVR HDMI
notes: Display-only Control4 AV source for the Ubiquiti UniFi NVR G2 HDMI live-view output. Exposes a single HDMI OUT binding so the NVR feed can be routed through an AV matrix and selected in Watch. Controls nothing and reports nothing by design; the binding is the whole point. Field-proven routing video on an AVPro Edge matrix; factory build adds self-update, validation, tests, and packaged docs the hand-built v1-v3 never had.
